preprocessing.transform: log1p first five nonnegative descriptors; StandardScaler fitted on train

training.split: Artist-disjoint deterministic train/validation/test. Preprocessing fitted only on train. Production models remain fitted on train; all rows transformed for browsing.

0.name: Velvet Frequencies
0.description: This group has relatively higher rms level and lower spectral rolloff in this feature corpus. Its name is an editorial interpretation of measured recordings.

provenance.source: FMA: A Dataset for Music Analysis (Defferrard et al., ISMIR 2017)
provenance.license: CC BY 4.0 (metadata and precomputed descriptors; audio licenses differ)
provenance.note: FMA feature records are not linked to Jamendo playback. No synthetic observations.

em.note: Curve is the best GMM fit actual EM iteration lower bounds. Responsibilities shown at final fitted parameters, not invented intermediate iterations.

factors.note: Unrotated factors; signs and semantic interpretations are not unique.

dimensions.rule: Factor count selected by artist-held-out validation likelihood; PCA variance threshold is descriptive, not an accuracy score.

evaluation.limitations: Internal clustering quality is not listener satisfaction. Source genre tags are not ground-truth acoustic clusters. Two PCA axes discard variance. No psychological validation.
